decisions.subject: May a ledger-gated step's forced bracket run before its standalone capture when its recipe passes no force env?
decisions.recommendation: Yes, as an amendment note on R-DQ / Spec 132 §x-captures.1: a ledger-gated step's (execution.shape materialize or cascade) forced bracket runs before that step's standalone capture when its recipe passes no force env (the standalone writes the owned baseline; a later bracket would gate-skip). Implemented as two REORDER pairs in the fleet-night split-blocks.cjs (classify_coa_trades, compute_coa_cost_estimates); no scripts/lib/step/** change, no descriptor change, no RE-FREEZE.
